name: skir-elixir-gen
description: Native Elixir code generation and SkirRPC support for Skir schemas

scripts.test:elixir: npm run generate:fixtures && cd example && mix deps.get && mix test
scripts.check: node --check src/generator.js && node --check src/naming.js && node --check src/index.js
scripts.generate: npm run configure && cd example && skir gen
scripts.test:runtime: cd runtime && mix deps.get && mix test
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:elixir && npm run test:rpc-parity && npm run test:integration
